jobs.title: Grant & Budget Analyst
jobs.description:
**ESSENTIAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES** include the following. Other duties and responsibilities may be assigned.

The Phoenix Houses of Long Island, Inc. is seeking a qualified candidate to fill the full-time position of Grant Accountant, in the Finance Department.

This position provides technical accounting, budget and other administrative support for Program Managers, under the direction of the Controller. Responsibilities include monitoring,

analyzing and maintaining financial transactions for a wide variety of OASAS, OMH and other Federal, New York State, and New York City funded programs; tracking revenues and expenditures, and preparing required internal and external financial reports.

**Duties and Responsibilities:**

Under the direct supervision of the Controller, the Grant Accountant will be responsible for the following:

* Provide advanced, technical grants accounting support work for Program Managers and department programs.
* Monitor, analyze and maintain financial transactions and accounting for a wide variety of programs funded by Federal, state and local grants.
* Track revenues and expenditures by funding source. Reconcile grant and program financial statements to the general ledger by fund which may include many different grants.
* Review data, identify errors through analysis, research, and interpretation of data, and provide recommendations to the General Ledger team and/or Program Manager in determining corrective action.
* Provide accounting information and technical assistance to program managers and work with funding agencies to maintain compliance with grant requirements.
* Report financial grant information from a variety of revenue sources. Prepare a variety of reports, statements, records, analyses, and financial compilations for Federal, state, and local regulatory agencies with various reporting periods according to specifications according to program needs. Prepare grant close-outs reports.
* Prepare financial projections for RFPs, and grant applications.

Bill on contract awards and prepare the necessary billing documents, as appropriate. Track due dates and prepare reports for grantor agencies, verify invoices for allowable costs, and prepare monthly grant requests for reimbursement.

* Maintain and document internal accounting controls as required by Federal, state and local grantors to ensure appropriate use of public funds. Must be familiar with OMB Circular A133 and related pronouncements regarding Federal, state and local pass-through funds.
* Assist in development and implementation of administrative, program and subcontract budgets. Contribute to developing modifications to procedures and internal controls.
* Maintain knowledge of Finance department operations and systems. Perform work within accounting parameters established by the department and applicable Federal and state laws and regulations.
* Perform other duties as assigned

**Qualifications**

Four years of progressive accounting experience, at least two of which are directly related to grant accounting,

OR

A Bachelor’s degree or the equivalent, in accounting, finance, business administration or a related field from an accredited college or university. Any combination of training and experience that would provide the required knowledge, skills and abilities will be considered

**Job Requirements**

* Proficient in Microsoft Office, particularly Excel.
* Ability to research and analyze data and resolve issues; read, interpret and apply policies, procedures, laws, and regulations, read and interpret medical procedures and terminology.
* Knowledge of OASAS and/or OMH regulations, a plus
* Ability to function independently, attend to detail, work under pressure, and complete tasks on time.
* Solid knowledge of US GAAP, Federal and State grants regulations, and governmental and nonprofit budgetary accounting;
* Solid knowledge of Accounting Information Systems and financial statements.
* Advanced data analysis skills and Excel skills, high proficiency with MS Word;
* Strong research ability and ability to manage multiple programs in high-pressure environment;
* Detail oriented and extremely organized;
* Effective, persuasive written and verbal communication skills;
* BS in Accounting and minimum of two-years nonprofit experience;
* Proficiency in MS Office, mainly Excel

jobs.title: Board Certified Behavior Analyst - OCEAN County
jobs.description:
**Board Certified Behavior Analyst (BCBA) / Licensed Behavior Analyst (LBA)**

**Location(s): IN HOME | OCEAN COUNTY** **.**

**Immediate Need in following areas:** Jackson, Toms River, Brick, Barnegat, and surrounding areas.

**Employment Type: W-2 | Per Diem, Part-Time**  
**Reports To: Clinical Leadership**

**Compensation: $65-$75/HR. + Bonus**  
**Schedule:** **3:00 PM - 7:00 PM** | *The greatest service need is generally after-school and early evening hours, although opportunities may vary based on individual family needs.*

**About Step Up Family Services:** At Step Up Family Services, we believe meaningful change begins with meeting individuals and families where they are. We provide individualized, high-quality behavioral health services that build on individual strengths and create lasting progress in the communities we serve. Our Applied Behavior Analysis (ABA) services support children and families through evidence-based interventions delivered in home, center-based, and community settings. We are seeking dedicated BCBA/LBA professionals who are passionate about clinical excellence, developing Behavior Technicians, and helping children achieve meaningful outcomes.

**Position Summary**: The **BCBA/LBA** provides clinical leadership and oversight of Applied Behavior Analysis (ABA) services for children and families served by Step Up Family Services. This role is responsible for conducting assessments, developing and monitoring individualized treatment and Behavior Support Plans (BSPs), analyzing client progress, supervising and developing BTs/RBTs, and partnering with families to support meaningful and sustainable outcomes.

The BCBA/LBA is expected to exercise independent clinical decision-making while maintaining high standards of ethical practice, documentation, collaboration, and regulatory compliance.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Conduct comprehensive client assessments and Functional Behavior Assessments (FBAs) and use findings to identify treatment priorities and clinical recommendations.
* Develop, implement, monitor, and modify individualized treatment plans and Behavior Support Plans (BSPs) based on assessment findings, client needs, family input, and measurable clinical goals.
* Analyze client data and treatment outcomes to evaluate effectiveness, identify barriers to progress, and make data-informed clinical decisions and treatment modifications.
* Provide ongoing supervision, observation, coaching, and clinical direction to BTs/RBTs, ensuring treatment fidelity, staff competency, and appropriate implementation of treatment protocols.
* Partner with parents and caregivers through education, training, modeling, and ongoing communication to promote treatment consistency and generalization of skills across environments.
* Collaborate with families, BTs/RBTs, clinical leadership, schools, providers, and other members of the care team to support coordinated and clinically appropriate care.
* Maintain ownership of assigned caseloads, including authorized service hours, supervision requirements, scheduling, reassessments, treatment-plan updates, and required clinical documentation.
* Identify and appropriately respond to clinical, ethical, safety, or professional-boundary concerns, including consultation and escalation when necessary.
* Complete all clinical documentation, assessments, treatment plans, supervision records, and other required records accurately and within established timeframes, utilizing Step Up’s required electronic systems.
* Maintain compliance with BACB ethical requirements, New Jersey licensure requirements, payer/funding requirements, Step Up policies, and all applicable professional and regulatory standards.

**Qualifications**

* Master’s degree or higher in Applied Behavior Analysis, Psychology, Education, or another qualifying related field.
* Demonstrated experience providing ABA services and developing individualized behavioral treatment interventions.
* Experience conducting FBAs, developing treatment/BSPs, analyzing clinical data, and modifying interventions based on client progress.
* Experience supervising, coaching, or developing BTs/RBTs or other direct-care clinical staff.
* Strong clinical decision-making, communication, organization, documentation, and interpersonal skills.
* Ability to work effectively and independently across in-home and/or center-based environments while maintaining strong collaboration with families and the broader clinical team.
* Reliable transportation and ability to travel to assigned client homes, community settings, or Step Up centers as required.
* Must successfully meet all required background checks, fingerprinting, credentialing, training, and other employment requirements.

**Credential Requirements**

* Must hold and maintain an active Board-Certified Behavior Analyst (BCBA) certification through the Behavior Analyst Certification Board (BACB).
* Must hold and maintain an active New Jersey Licensed Behavior Analyst (LBA) license, or meet applicable requirements for NJ licensure prior to independently providing services requiring licensure.
* Must maintain all continuing education, supervision, renewal, and other requirements necessary to keep applicable certification and licensure in good standing.

**Core Expectations:** Successful BCBA/LBAs at Step Up are expected to demonstrate:

* Clinical Excellence: Individualized, evidence-based and data-informed care.
* Leadership: Active development, coaching, and accountability of BTs/RBTs.
* Family Partnership: Respectful, collaborative relationships with children and caregivers.
* Ownership: Proactive management of caseloads, authorized services, documentation, and clinical responsibilities.
* Collaboration: Open communication and partnership across the clinical team.
* Integrity: Consistent ethical, professional, and compliant clinical practice.

jobs.title: Lead QA Business Analyst
jobs.description:
**About Heady:**
================

Heady architects purchase experiences in store, online, and through AI agents. We help brands sell goods and services to humans — in person and online — and increasingly, to and through the agents now shopping on their behalf. Our expertise spans everything that goes into making a purchase happen: the software and infrastructure behind it, the experience that enables it, and the loyalty that follows. Learn more about us at Heady.io. We’re a relationship-driven, craft-focused, and people-first company. Our clients trust us not just to execute, but to think alongside them—and we take that responsibility seriously.

**Job Requirements:**
---------------------

Heady is looking for a detail-oriented and hands-on Lead QA Business Analyst to join our team. In this position, you will own the quality assurance and testing of a cross-platform, custom e-commerce raffle system. You will be expected to coordinate across client, vendor, and internal teams to run thorough testing of our system for ongoing feature development. To be successful in this role, you will need to be proactive in coming up with solutions to not only improve the quality of our product, but also our testing process overall. The role is based in New York, NY, with a hybrid work model (Tuesdays & Wednesdays in the DUMBO, Brooklyn office).

  

**What You’ll Do:**
-------------------

* Create and execute the testing strategy for an online raffle and inventory management system, including full-stack and API testing to independently uncover the root cause of issues.
* Lead weekly QA meetings and cross-functional standups, managing ticket assignments and keeping teams aligned on priorities and blockers.
* Coordinate test data acquisition across teams and manage defect prioritization according to business goals and release timelines.
* Translate business requirements documents (BRDs) into epics, tickets, and functional specification documents (FSDs); support testing and release coordination through feature delivery.
* Write clear, well-structured business requirements and convert them into detailed acceptance criteria.
* Initiate and maintain documentation — including release notes, FSDs, and feature documentation — in Confluence.
* Conduct competitive and feature analysis to identify experience gaps and propose solutions that improve product quality and the overall testing process.
* Diligently identify edge cases and write thorough test cases; manage test case execution and tracking using TestRail.
* Coordinate across the software development team and with Product Managers to test new and existing features.
* Contribute to backlog planning and participate in Product Manager-level strategic discussions and workshops.
* Help onboard new team members, orienting them to relevant tools, systems, and processes
* Support holiday readiness and provide on-call coverage via ZenDuty for emergency application support.
* Coordinate with client, vendor, and internal stakeholders — both technical and non-technical — across different time zones, including with offshore development teams.

  

**Job Requirements:**
---------------------

Bachelor’s degree or a foreign equivalent in Computer Science or a related field and 3 years of experience in the job or related field. Education, training, or experience to include:

* Agile software development and backlog management (e.g., Jira, Confluence).
* Professional experience working across different time zones, including with a partial or full offshore development team.
* Strong familiarity with Consumer-facing mobile applications, including release management and distribution (Firebase App Distribution, Apple App Store, Google Play Store) and mobile  
  analytics/crash reporting (Firebase).
* Experience with API testing using Postman, PAW, and RapidAPI, and proxy testing tool Charles Proxy.
* Experience with Salesforce OCAPI (Open Commerce API).
* Experience with the test case management platform TestRail.

  

**Hybrid role** must work 2 days per week at Heady office in Brooklyn, NY.

**Hours:** Monday through Friday, 40 hours per week, 9:30-5:30 pm.

**Location:** Brooklyn, NY - Hybrid role; must work 2 days per week at Heady's Brooklyn office.

**Salary:** $107,349-$110,000 per year

**How to apply:** Click "apply" below to fill out an application or email your resume with a cover letter to: Molly Takemoto, People Ops Manager, molly@heady.com, Attn: Job Code: 10534393.

  

This notice is being provided as a result of the filing of an application for alien employment certification for the job offered. Any person may provide documentary evidence bearing on the application to the U.S. Department of Labor, Employment and Training Administration, Office of Foreign Labor Certification, 200 Constitution Avenue NW, Room N-5311, Washington, DC 20210.

jobs.title: Master Data Analyst
jobs.description:
Welcome to Haleon. We’re a purpose-driven, world-class consumer company putting everyday health in the hands of millions. In just three years since our launch, we’ve grown, evolved and are now entering an exciting new chapter – one filled with bold ambitions and enormous opportunity.
  
  
Our trusted portfolio of brands – including Sensodyne®, Panadol®, Advil®, Voltaren®, Theraflu®, Otrivin®, and Centrum® – lead in resilient and growing categories. What sets us apart is our unique blend of deep human understanding and trusted science.
  
  
Now it’s time to fully realise the full potential of our business and our people. We do this through our Win as One strategy. It puts our purpose – to deliver better everyday health with humanity – at the heart of everything we do. It unites us, inspires us, and challenges us to be better every day, driven by our agile, performance-focused culture.

The **Master Data Analyst** is responsible for the end-to-end setup, maintenance, and synchronization of master data supporting North America Supply and Demand Planning and Haleon's customers and retailers.

The role serves as a key point of contact for master data-related inquiries and is responsible for maintaining data quality, accuracy, and system integrity. The Master Data Analyst also supports NPI activities, process improvements, system enhancements, and implementation initiatives to drive efficient and standardized master data processes.

**Key Responsibilities**

**Data Management**

* Collect, validate, and maintain master data in collaboration with key stakeholders.
* Create and maintain master data in SAP systems, including GMM, ECC, and APO, across plants, sales organizations, distribution channels, and storage locations supporting the U.S., Puerto Rico, and Canada.
* Generate and maintain UPCs and GTINs through PIM.
* Support the NPI process by ensuring required master data and SKU setup activities are completed prior to product launch.
* Publish and synchronize product data with retailers.
* Monitor data quality reports, resolve identified issues, and complete required standard work.
* Manage SKU lifecycle activities and maintain accurate master data throughout the product lifecycle.
Create and maintain vendor master data.  

**Process Improvement**

* Perform root cause analysis on master data and process issues and implement corrective and continuous improvement actions.
* Identify opportunities to simplify, standardize, and improve master data processes and ways of working.
Collaborate with Planning, Customer Service, Sites, and other key stakeholders to promote consistent data management practices.  

**Systems and Project Support**

* Support master data process development, system implementations, data verification, and system enhancements.
* Identify opportunities to improve master data systems and related processes.
Partner with cross-functional teams to understand changes impacting master data and incorporate new processes and ways of working within the Planning Hub.  

**Documentation**

Maintain and update Master Data Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs) and supporting documentation.  



**Basic Qualifications**

  

* Bachelor’s degree in Data Science, Supply Chain, Technical, or a related field.
* 3 years’ experience in master data management or master data maintenance.
* Previous SAP ERP system experience.
* Strong attention-to-detail.
Ability to work independently while collaborating effectively in a team environment.  

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Working knowledge of 1WorldSync, STIBO, and/or Salsify.
* Knowledge of master data requirements supporting Supply and Demand Planning processes.
* Familiarity with Power Apps, Power Automate, or other automation tools.

Experience supporting process improvement and/or system development initiatives.  



**Location: This role is hybrid-based in Berkeley Heights, NJ with 3 in-office days required.**

**The salary range for this role is: $108,530 - $149,229 plus a 12% target bonus.**

**Benefits**
------------

Haleon offers a robust Total Reward package that consists of competitive pay and a comprehensive benefits program. jobs.title: Tax Software QA & Support Analyst
jobs.description:
**A Different Kind Of Job Description**
---------------------------------------

At Filed, we believe in radical transparency. Everything is open: company finances, team salaries, stock options, anonymous team feedback. That extends to how we talk about this job. So instead of a list of perks, we'll start with what's genuinely hard about it, then tell you why it might be the best move you'll make.

### **What's hard about this job**

**Bugs don't arrive with instructions.** A customer tells you "it didn't work." Your job is to work out exactly what they did, with which return, in which tax software, and make it happen again on your own screen. If you can't reproduce it, engineering can't fix it.

**Your ticket is the fix's starting point.** Engineers will build from what you write. Vague steps mean days of back and forth while a firm waits. You'll need to be precise every time.

**The pace is fast.** Our customers are tax firms in their busiest weeks. When something breaks, they need an answer today, and a workaround while the real fix is built.

**It isn't fixed until you've checked.** You'll retest every fix before telling a customer it's resolved, and you'll recheck after releases that nothing else broke.

### **Why it might be the best career move you'll make**

**You'll sit between customers and engineering.** Few roles see both sides this clearly. You'll learn how real firms use tax software, and how software actually gets built.

**Your work ships.** A bug you reproduce on Monday becomes a fix every firm on Filed benefits from. A workaround you find saves a firm hours the same day.

**You'll grow as fast as we do.** Filed is adding millions of dollars of revenue every quarter, and the support and QA function is still small. People who start here move into QA, product and engineering-adjacent roles.

We've raised $17.2 million to date, led by Northzone, and we work with tax firms across the country, from regional practices to some of the biggest names in the profession.

### **What You'll Own**

* Reproducing customer-reported issues step by step, inside Filed and the tax software firms already use
* Writing clear, complete Linear tickets with exact steps, expected versus actual results, screenshots and sample data, so engineers can act straight away
* Answering customer tickets quickly and clearly in our support inbox
* Troubleshooting technical issues and finding workarounds that keep firms moving
* Verifying fixes before they go back to the customer, and regression testing after releases
* Spotting patterns across tickets and flagging them before they spread

### **Your Hard Skillset**

* Hands-on QA or software testing experience: you've reproduced bugs and written them up for an engineering team
* Customer support experience in a ticketing system such as Pylon, Zendesk, Intercom or Freshdesk
* A tax background, either at a tax or accounting firm, at a tax software company, or preparing returns yourself. You don't need to be a preparer, but you should know your way around a return.
* Familiarity with at least one major tax platform, such as CCH Axcess, UltraTax, Lacerte, ProConnect, Drake or GoSystem
* Bonus if you've used Linear or Jira, browser developer tools or screen recording to capture issues

### **Your Soft Skillset**

* Methodical: you change one thing at a time until you find what breaks
* Clear writing: your tickets and replies leave no room for confusion
* Curious: you want to know why something broke, not just that it did
* Calm and patient with customers who are under deadline pressure
* You take ownership and follow a problem through to the fix

### **Who This Suits**

* People who enjoy hunting down a problem more than answering the same question twice
* Support professionals who want to move into QA and product
* Tax professionals who want to move into tech without leaving their expertise behind

### **How We Pay**

Nothing at Filed is behind closed doors. Everyone sees everyone else's salary, and compensation isn't a negotiation. Depending on your location, everyone at the same level receives the same three offers.

This role is assessed at Level 1. The salary and equity bandings are:

* **Most Equity:** $77,000 per year + $100,020 of equity
* **Great Equity:** $84,000 per year + $66,680 of equity
* **Good Equity:** $91,000 per year + $33,340 of equity

We run performance reviews every four months, so strong work is recognized quickly.

### **Benefits**

* **Platinum-level medical insurance**, fully covered for you, with 100% coverage for your dependents as well
* **Dental insurance**
* **Vision insurance**
* **401(k)** retirement plan
* **Paid maternity and paternity leave**
* **A minimum of 30 days of paid holiday** every year
* **Your choice of the latest and greatest computers**, plus a budget for your home office setup
* **Company-wide offsites** every four months

### **The process**

* Quick intro call (30 minutes)
* Bug reproduction exercise: we give you a real-style customer report, you reproduce the issue and write the ticket (60 minutes)
* Final round with Rachel and the team (60 minutes)

### **About Filed**

Filed is the AI tax preparer trusted by America's accounting firms. It works inside the software firms already use, and takes on the work surrounding the accountant so tax professionals can spend their time on judgment, advice and their clients. We're backed by Northzone, Neo, Analog and Raine.

**About Gap Inc.**
------------------

At Gap Inc., we create culture as much as we create clothes. Our ambition is to become a high-performing house of iconic American brands that shape culture.

Our portfolio—Old Navy, Gap, Banana Republic, and Athleta—each brings a distinct point of view to how we show up in the world and serve our customers.

Old Navy democratizes style with quality and value for all. Gap champions originality through essential pieces that celebrate individuality. Banana Republic is rooted in a spirit of discovery, creating modern pieces inspired by craftsmanship and travel. Athleta champions the Power of She through confidence, strength, and movement.

We’re driven by a shared purpose: to bridge gaps—between people, perspectives, and possibilities—to create a better world.

We’re building a team that performs at a high level—people who think boldly, take ownership, and turn ideas into impact. If you’re ready to learn fast and help shape what’s next, you’ll fit right in.

**About the role**
------------------

The Pricing Optimization Associate supports pricing analytics and decision support across Gap brand. In this role, you will complete foundational analyses and prepare inputs for pricing strategy, price testing, competitive pricing insights, pricing architecture, promotion scenario planning, markdown optimization, yield management, and forecast tuning. This role operates as part of Gap Inc.'s Pricing, Planning Analytics, and Inventory Optimization function, working with business partners and more experienced team members while following consistent decision standards, approved AI-enabled tools, and transparent analytical methods.

**What you'll do**
------------------

**Analytical Execution**

* Complete recurring pricing analyses, data preparation, model inputs, scenario runs, reporting, and recommendation materials using established methods and templates.
* Check data and outputs for completeness and accuracy; identify inconsistencies, risks, and patterns, and escalate questions when needed.
* Prepare clear summaries, visuals, and decision-support materials that explain findings and relevant business implications.
* Maintain accurate records of assumptions, outputs, approvals, actions, and hindsights in the decision log.

**Scenario Support and Insight Development**

* Support pricing, promotion, markdown, and yield-management scenarios; learn how revenue, margin, sell-through, customer value, and inventory exposure shape trade-offs.
* Analyze elasticity, competitive, category, channel, and customer signals and summarize implications for pricing recommendations and guardrails.
* Coordinate with GMM, Merchandising, Planning, Inventory Optimization, Pricing Operations, and Finance to gather inputs, confirm execution constraints, and support approved price actions.
* Share analyses with peers across Planning, Pricing, and Inventory Optimization to connect work and reduce siloed execution.

**Tools, AI and Continuous Learning**

* Use approved AI-enabled tools, models, dashboards, and agents responsibly; validate outputs against source data, business context, and known constraints, seeking guidance for exceptions.
* Build knowledge of Gap Inc. planning, pricing, inventory, merchandising, and financial processes and apply that knowledge to assigned work.
* Follow established workflows and contribute practical ideas to improve templates, data quality, recurring work, and the usability of insights.

**Business Partnership and Quality Contribution**

* Deliver accurate, timely work; communicate progress and risks, seek feedback, and bring curiosity, responsiveness, and a service mindset to business partners and team members.

**Who you are**
---------------

* Bachelor degree required in business, economics, finance, analytics, mathematics, statistics, engineering, retail, or related field.
* 1+ years of relevant analytical experience in retail, planning, pricing, inventory, finance, data analytics, consulting, or related fields.
* Foundational analytical, modeling, communication, and storytelling skills, with the ability to turn data into clear findings and practical next steps.
* Exposure to retail, apparel, consumer products, consulting, finance, data analytics, planning, pricing, inventory, or merchandising preferred.
* Comfort using Excel and data tools; exposure to BI platforms, SQL, Python, forecasting, optimization, pricing tools, or AI-enabled workflows preferred.
* Structured learner who follows established methods, asks thoughtful questions, and communicates clearly.
* Commercially curious and detail-oriented; interested in how customer, product, revenue, margin, inventory, service, and execution factors connect.
* Enterprise-minded and brand-aware; applies common standards while learning relevant brand context.
* Comfortable using AI-enabled tools and agentic workflows with human review, appropriate validation, and timely escalation of exceptions or risks.
* Collaborative team member who builds trust, responds with urgency, welcomes feedback, and contributes to continuous improvement.

**Salary Range:** $76,400.00 - $95,500.00  
Employee pay will vary based on factors such as qualifications, experience, skill level, competencies and work location. We will meet minimum wage or minimum of the pay range (whichever is higher) based on city, county and state requirements.

**Benefits at Gap Inc.**

* Merchandise discount for our brands: 50% off regular-priced merchandise at Old Navy, Gap, Banana Republic and Athleta, and 30% off at Outlet for all employees.

jobs.title: Compliance & Data Analyst, NYREACH
jobs.description:
Overview:

NYREACH is a Bronx-based non-profit focused on addressing health disparities through community-driven solutions. Our work connects individuals to healthcare and essential social services while building strong partnerships across New York City.

Job Summary:

The Compliance & Data Analyst will serve as a critical oversight, quality assurance, and audit-readiness role within NYREACH, supporting Social Care Network (SCN) activities under New York State’s 1115 Waiver. This role ensures that all SCN screenings, eligibility determinations, navigation activities, referrals, and documentation meet program requirements, PHS and SOMOS audit standards, and contractual compliance expectation.

The position functions as both a compliance lead and operational analyst. The Analyst will create and maintain operating processes and policies, monitor day-to-day compliance, audit data for accuracy, and work closely with Navigators, Program Leads, and Directors to ensure a consistent level of compliance, accuracy, and audit readiness across the program.

Responsibilities:

**Eligibility Assessment & Timeliness (High Priority)**

* Ensure eligibility assessments are completed within seven (7) calendar days of referral receipt, consistent with SCN and 1115 Waiver requirements
* Track timeliness metrics and maintain audit-ready evidence of assessment completion
* Escalate delays or barriers to Program Leads and Directors
* Develop standard workflows to support timely eligibility determinations

**Closed-Loop Referral Oversight (High Priority)**

* Monitor all internal and external referrals to ensure closed-loop completion, as required by PHS and SOMOS audit standards
* Conduct compliance follow-ups on open or aging referrals
* Verify referral outcomes are documented clearly and accurately in member records
* Flag and escalate unresolved referrals that present compliance risk

**Navigation & Billing Opportunity Review**

* Review member profiles and navigation records to identify missing or open navigation activities tied to billing opportunities
* Maintain navigation trackers to ensure no eligible service or reimbursement opportunity is missed
* Validate that navigation activities are supported by appropriate documentation and eligibility criteria
* Partner with Navigators to resolve documentation gaps prior to billing or reporting

**Documentation Quality & Care Plan Compliance**

* Ensure all notes, eligibility documentation, and care plans meet SCN documentation and audit standards
* Confirm care plans are updated based on screenings, referrals, and changes in member needs
* Enforce internal documentation standards aligned with PHS, SOMOS, and NYS DOH guidance

**Audit & Monitoring Functions**

* Conduct routine audits of a minimum of ten percent (10%) of enhanced-level members
* Validate that enhanced members are connected to required referrals and services
* Document audit findings, corrective actions, and resolution timelines
* Maintain audit logs and supporting evidence for internal and external review

**Client Action & Referral Validation**

* Review all Client Action items, including internal and external referrals
* Coordinate with Navigators to obtain required responses and documentation
* Decline or return referrals that lack sufficient documentation or eligibility support
* Track and report closure and resolution status of all Client Action items

**Policy, Process & Program Oversight**

* Create, document, and maintain operating procedures and compliance policies for SCN workflows
* Ensure processes remain aligned with evolving 1115 Waiver, SCN, PHS, and SOMOS guidance
* Communicate compliance expectations and policy updates to Navigators and leadership
* Serve as an internal subject matter expert on SCN compliance requirements

**Reporting & Data Analysis**

* Produce routine compliance, productivity, and audit-readiness reports
* Monitor key indicators tied to eligibility timeliness, referral closure, documentation quality, and billing readiness
* Analyze trends and identify operational or compliance risks
* Present findings and recommendations to Directors and executive leadership

**External Audit Leadership**

* Serve as the primary lead for all SCN-related audits conducted by PHS, SOMOS, and other oversight entities
* Coordinate audit preparation, data validation, and documentation submission
* Support Directors in audit response strategy, corrective action plans, and follow-up reporting
* Maintain continuous audit readiness across all SCN program activities

**Key Performance Targets**

* Eligibility assessments completed within 7 days: 95% (PHS/SOMOS timeliness standard)
* Closed-loop referral completion rate: 90% with documented outcomes
* Navigation activities supported by compliant documentation: 95%
* Care plans updated and compliant: 95%
* Enhanced-level members connected to required referrals: 100%
* Audit sample completion and issue resolution within required timeframes: 100%
* Zero material audit findings related to missing documentation or unsupported billing

Qualifications:

**Required Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree required; Master’s degree in public health, health administration, social work, or related field preferred
* Strong understanding of audit processes, documentation standards, and compliance monitoring

**Required Skills**

* Advanced analytical, reporting, and organizational skills
* Ability to work collaboratively with Navigators, Program Leads, Directors, and external partners
* Strong attention to detail and documentation accuracy
* Advanced Microsoft Excel skills; proficiency in Teams, Outlook, Word, and PowerPoint

**Preferred Experience**

* Experience with 1115 Waiver programs, Social Care Networks, Medicaid, or managed care compliance strongly preferred
* Experience supporting internal or external audits in a healthcare or social services setting

jobs.description:
About Mars Premier Care  
  
Mars Premier Care is seeking a dedicated, compassionate, and experienced Board Certified Behavior Analyst (BCBA) to join our behavioral health team in Newark, New Jersey. We are committed to providing quality behavioral health services that promote positive outcomes, skill development, independence, and an improved quality of life for the individuals and families we serve.  
  
The ideal candidate will be passionate about evidence-based behavioral interventions, clinical excellence, and collaborative care. This position offers a flexible hybrid work arrangement, combining remote administrative responsibilities with in-person clinical services as needed.  
  
Job Duties and Responsibilities

* Conduct Functional Behavior Assessments (FBAs) and other appropriate behavioral assessments.
* Develop, implement, and monitor individualized behavior intervention and treatment plans.
* Provide clinical supervision, guidance, and support to Registered Behavior Technicians (RBTs) and other behavioral health staff, as applicable.
* Monitor client progress through data collection, analysis, and ongoing evaluation of treatment effectiveness.
* Conduct direct observations and provide clinical support in homes, schools, agency settings, and community environments as appropriate.
* Train and support parents, caregivers, and staff in implementing behavioral strategies and treatment recommendations.
* Collaborate with families and multidisciplinary professionals to coordinate care and promote positive client outcomes.
* Complete clinical assessments, progress notes, treatment plans, reports, and other required documentation accurately and within established deadlines.
* Participate in case reviews, team meetings, and treatment planning discussions.
* Ensure services are delivered in accordance with ethical standards, HIPAA requirements, applicable New Jersey regulations, payer requirements, and agency policies.
* Provide staff training, performance feedback, and ongoing clinical recommendations.
* Maintain professional relationships with clients, families, referral sources, and community partners.
* Travel to client locations as needed to provide assessments, supervision, and clinical services.

Schedule and Flexibility  
  
Mars Premier Care offers a flexible schedule designed to accommodate clinical responsibilities and client needs.

* Monday–Friday: Flexible scheduling based on caseload and service requirements.
* Some Saturdays: Availability needed periodically for client sessions, assessments, caregiver training, or supervision.
* Hybrid Work Environment: A combination of remote documentation, treatment planning, virtual meetings when appropriate, and in-person clinical responsibilities.
* Flexible Hours: Work hours coordinated with management based on client schedules, caseload requirements, and agency needs.
* Candidates should be comfortable balancing remote administrative tasks with in-person clinical responsibilities.

Qualifications and Requirements

* Active BCBA certification through the Behavior Analyst Certification Board (BACB).
* Master’s degree or higher in Applied Behavior Analysis, Psychology, Education, or a related field.
* Knowledge of evidence-based behavioral interventions, assessment procedures, and treatment planning.
* Experience supervising RBTs or behavioral health staff preferred.
* Strong communication, organization, documentation, and clinical decision-making skills.
* Ability to work independently and collaboratively with families and multidisciplinary teams.
* Familiarity with electronic health records and clinical documentation systems.
* Ability to travel to client locations as required.
* Must meet applicable New Jersey credentialing, background-check, and payer enrollment requirements for assigned services.

What Mars Premier Care Offers

* Flexible scheduling, Monday–Friday, with some Saturdays as needed.
* Hybrid work opportunities.
* A supportive and collaborative work environment.
* Opportunities to make a meaningful difference in the lives of individuals and families.
* Professional growth and continuing education opportunities.
* Competitive compensation based on experience and qualifications.
* PTO(Vacation & Sick Time)
* 401k (Retirement Plan)

Flexible work from home options available.

jobs.title: Data Analyst
jobs.description:
**Job Overview**

We are seeking a dynamic and detail-oriented Data Analyst to join our innovative team! In this role, you will harness your analytical expertise to transform complex data into actionable insights that drive strategic decision-making. Your passion for data visualization, business intelligence, and technical proficiency will empower our organization to optimize operations, enhance customer experiences, and uncover new growth opportunities. This is an exciting opportunity for someone eager to make a tangible impact through data-driven solutions and collaborative problem-solving.

**Duties**

* Develop and maintain comprehensive dashboards and reports using tools such as Tableau, Power BI, and Looker to visualize key performance metrics.
* Design and implement efficient ETL (Extract, Transform, Load) processes to ensure high-quality data integration from diverse sources including SQL databases, Oracle, Talend, and linked data sets.
* Collaborate with business stakeholders to gather requirements, analyze needs, and translate them into effective data models and analytical solutions.
* Conduct detailed data analysis using R, Python, Excel data analysis techniques, and other analytics tools to identify trends, patterns, and anomalies.
* Support the software development lifecycle (SDLC) by participating in requirements analysis, testing, deployment, and ongoing maintenance of analytics solutions within an Agile environment.
* Manage query optimization and database design for SQL Server and Oracle databases to improve performance and ensure reliable reporting.
* Create clear documentation of processes, data models, and technical specifications using Visio or similar tools to facilitate knowledge sharing.

**Experience**

* Proven experience as a Data Analyst or Business Intelligence Analyst with a strong portfolio of developing dashboards and reports.
* Proficiency in SQL query management, database design, and working with SQL databases such as Microsoft SQL Server or Oracle.
* Skilled in using data visualization tools including Tableau, Power BI, and Looker for dashboard development and reporting.
* Hands-on experience with ETL tools like Talend or scripting languages such as Python, R, Bash (Unix shell), or VBA for automation tasks.
* Familiarity with the software development lifecycle (SDLC), Agile methodologies, and project management principles related to analytics projects.
* Strong understanding of business analysis techniques including requirements analysis and business intelligence strategies.
* Knowledge of linked data concepts and experience in integrating disparate data sources for comprehensive analysis.
* Excellent analysis skills complemented by the ability to communicate insights effectively through visualizations and reports.

Join us if you’re passionate about turning complex datasets into compelling stories that inform strategic decisions! We value technical excellence combined with innovative thinking — your expertise will help shape our future success!

jobs.description:
**Job Requirements**  

**Disney Entertainment and ESPN Product & Technology**

Technology is at the heart of Disney’s past, present, and future. Disney Entertainment and ESPN Product & Technology is a global organization of engineers, product developers, designers, technologists, data scientists, and more – all working to build and advance the technological backbone for Disney’s media business globally.

The team marries technology with creativity to build world-class products, enhance storytelling, and drive velocity, innovation, and scalability for our businesses. We are Storytellers and Innovators. Creators and Builders. Entertainers and Engineers. We work with every part of The Walt Disney Company’s media portfolio to advance the technological foundation and consumer media touch points serving millions of people around the world.

Here are a few reasons why we think you’d love working here:

**1. Building the future of Disney’s media:** Our Technologists are designing and building the products and platforms that will power our media, advertising, and distribution businesses for years to come.

**2. Reach, Scale & Impact:** More than ever, Disney’s technology and products serve as a signature doorway for fans' connections with the company’s brands and stories. Disney+. Hulu. ESPN. ABC. ABC News…and many more. These products and brands – and the unmatched stories, storytellers, and events they carry – matter to millions of people globally.

**3. Innovation:** We develop and implement groundbreaking products and techniques that shape industry norms, and solve complex and distinctive technical problems.

Product & Technology Analytics is responsible for the data analysis, measurement, and insight generation that inform product strategy and decision-making across Disney Entertainment’s streaming and digital portfolio. This includes experimentation analysis, KPI development, BI development, and cross-functional partnership with product management, engineering, and programming teams to drive data-informed outcomes across Disney+ and Hulu.

**Job Summary:**

The Product & Technology Analytics team is seeking a Lead Data Analyst who will be a key player in driving personalization strategy on Disney+ and Hulu.

Our ideal candidate is an excellent coder and communicator who crafts high-impact, data-informed stories to decode challenging and unstructured problems, and can responsibly manage complex projects that cross several silos. If you go beyond gathering data and you consistently transform it into knowledge and meaningful business action, this is a great role for you.

You’ll contribute the following to this critical squad:

* **Deep-Dive Research:** Lead large-scale analyses of product performance and user behavior. Apply statistical modeling, experimentation, and causal inference to identify opportunities and influence product strategy.
* **A/B Testing & Experimentation:** Lead the design, analysis, and interpretation of personalization experiments, including power analysis, metric selection, SQL/Python analysis, and stakeholder recommendations.
* **Analytics Foundations:** Partner with product and data engineering teams to improve data quality, build scalable datasets, and instrument new product features for reliable analysis and reporting.
* **AI-Enabled Analytics:** Use and help advance AI-assisted tools and workflows to improve the speed, scale, and quality of analysis.
* **Ad Hoc Analysis:** Investigate product issues, analyze user behavior, and rapidly answer complex business and product questions using large datasets.

**Minimum Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree in Statistics, Economics, Mathematics, Computer Science, Data Analytics, or another technical field
* 7+ years of data analytics experience, including 3+ years in a senior or lead-level capacity.
* Advanced SQL and Python skills, including complex analysis of large datasets, notebook-based workflows, and scheduled analytical jobs.
* Advanced knowledge of experimentation and statistical analysis, including hypothesis testing, power analysis, metric selection, regression, causal inference, test design, and interpretation.
* Product analytics experience, including user behavior, funnels, engagement, and feature performance.
* Experience building analyses, dashboards, and visualizations in Looker, Tableau, or a comparable BI platform.
* Proven ability to lead end-to-end analytical projects, define requirements, manage timelines, partner with data engineering, and deliver strategic outcomes.
* Strategic communication skills, with the ability to translate complex findings into clear recommendations for technical, business, and executive audiences.
* Experience building or applying AI-assisted analytics tools and workflows.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Background in streaming media or subscription-based products
* Advanced knowledge of Looker
* Proven ability to manage projects that require new datasets, collaborating with data engineering teams to improve data quality and build foundational datasets for scalable analysis
* Master’s degree in Statistics, Economics, Mathematics, Computer Science, Data Analytics, or another technical field

This role supports senior US Equity investors—primarily Portfolio Managers—who run large, complex mandates across multiple products and investment strategies. The role provides exposure to institutional portfolio construction, risk management, and the operational mechanics that enable scalable, client-aligned execution.

**Job summary:**

As a Portfolio Management Program Analyst in the US Equities team, you will help drive day-to-day portfolio activities while building deep knowledge of the team's investment engine, including its philosophy, process, research inputs, and the practical mechanics required to manage institutional-scale portfolios. In this role, you will operate as a trusted partner to Portfolio Managers—owning core analytics, monitoring, and execution support that helps keep portfolios aligned with intent, constraints, and evolving market conditions.

**Job responsibilities:**

Portfolio Management

* Partner closely with senior US Equity investors to support the ongoing management of large mandates across a range of strategies and client objectives. You will help ensure portfolios remain aligned with investment intent, risk parameters, and implementation requirements.
* Build expertise in the team's investment engine by developing a strong understanding of the end-to-end investment process, including portfolio construction, risk management, and performance attribution.

Portfolio Implementation

* Support Portfolio Managers with portfolio implementation activities, including assisting with order workflows and contributing to portfolio and market monitoring. You will help ensure implementation is accurate, timely, and consistent with portfolio guidelines and investment objectives.
* Assist with new client onboarding and portfolio transitions by reviewing account guidelines, restrictions, and required constraints. You will contribute to transaction and tax-cost analysis and support investment performance reviews to ensure portfolios are implemented thoughtfully and efficiently.

* Continuously monitor portfolio positioning, exposures, and key trends, incorporating relevant market developments and news to inform the team's decision-making. You will help connect market activity to portfolio implications in a clear, actionable way.
* Deliver rigorous, insight-driven analysis to Portfolio Managers, helping to inform investment decisions and portfolio strategy. This includes identifying what is changing, why it matters, and what actions may be required.
* Proactively identify risks, gaps, and process improvement opportunities—especially in response to evolving markets, new information, or observed operational friction. You will recommend practical enhancements to strengthen decision-making, controls, and repeatability.

**Company**
-----------

Federal Reserve Bank of New YorkWhen you work at the New York Fed, you have the opportunity to make an impact in our communities and across the nation. Our mission-driven, curious, and dedicated colleagues apply their diverse perspectives and unique talents to support the strength of the U.S. economy and stability of the global financial system. At the Bank, we work full-time onsite with our teams. We believe being physically together allows us to draw on our collective strengths, while recognizing that the ability to work flexibly from time to time remains important to achieving our mission.

**Our Unique Work:**

The New York Fed, on behalf of the Federal Reserve System, offers correspondent banking and custody services to foreign central banks and international monetary authorities (FIMA) and the System Open Market Account (SOMA) to facilitate their official financial operations, as well as support financial stability operations in the U.S. and abroad. The Central Bank and International Account Services (CBIAS) area of the New York Fed's Markets Group serves the U.S. dollar reserve management needs of its official customers by offering payments, custodial, clearing and settlement, collateral management, and investment and liquidity services. CBIAS has a long history of providing safe and efficient banking services to its customer base by managing over $7 trillion for FIMA customers and SOMA with transaction volume presently exceeding $300 billion per day. CBIAS maintains operating locations in New York City (FRB-NY) and Richmond, Virginia (FRB-R).

The Account Transaction Monitoring (ATM) and Account Risk Analytics (ARA) staff units are two of three units within the Account Risk Management (ARM) Directorate within CBIAS. The ARM Directorate is responsible for risk management activities for its international account services. As the first line of defense for the FRBNY on these international accounts, ARM is principally focused on implementing anti-money laundering (AML), Office of Foreign Assets Control (OFAC) compliance, and fraud programs. The ATM staff conduct day-to-day operations and analytic initiatives related to account control, legal and reputational risk management activities associated with fraud, AML, and OFAC monitoring. The ARA staff supports and coordinates analysts with responsibility for the administration and operation of account control and legal and reputational risk management activities and the execution of AML and OFAC compliance programs.

* Develop regional geographic specialization to better understand risks presented by a global customer base.
* Provide analysis of customer trends and activity related to global activity.
* Participate in programs geared toward technological enhancements, risk reduction and improved customer service.
* Author and present briefings to management on transaction typologies, customer, or geopolitical developments or other topics which may present undesired compliance or reputational risk.
* Contribute to FIMA customer risk reviews using historical activity to identify higher risk typologies, summarize past engagement and provide rating recommendations.
* Analyze and manage the distribution of intelligence derived from open-source research, transaction analysis, and other sources.

* Ability to work independently with general supervision, and support projects/processes.

jobs.title: Sr. Software Engineer, Analytics & Data Platform
jobs.description:
**Who We Are**
==============

DV is the leader in digital performance solutions, helping our advertiser and agency partners Verify the quality of their digital campaigns, Optimise to improve performance and Prove that they’re achieving their business outcomes, through unbiased 3rd party data and analytics. DV’s mission is to be the definitive source of transparency and data-driven insights into the quality and effectiveness of digital advertising for the world’s largest brands, agencies, publishers, and digital ad platforms. Since 2008, DV has helped hundreds of Fortune 500 companies gain the most from their media spend by delivering best-in-class solutions across the digital advertising ecosystem, helping to build a better industry. Learn more at www.doubleverify.com.

**About the Role**
==================

**Role Overview**
-----------------

You will join the Data & Analytics Platform (DAP) team within the Pinnacle engineering organization. The DAP team owns and operates two data consolidation platforms — Quantum (contract-driven, next-gen) and Analytics 2.0 (SQL-driven, legacy) — that ingest, transform, and serve billions of records daily from social platforms, measurement systems, and third-party partners. The data powers Looker dashboards, customer-facing reports, and downstream APIs used across DoubleVerify's product suite.

**What You'll Do**
------------------

* Platform Abstraction & Design: Design and maintain the YAML-based "Contract" system that allows users to define data entities, transformations, and SLOs without writing low-level orchestration code.
* Infrastructure as Code (IaC): Develop the translation engine that converts user contracts into automated dbt models, Airflow DAGs, and Snowflake objects.
* API Development: Transition the platform from static configuration files to a dynamic, API-first architecture, enabling programmatic creation of data artifacts.
* Self-Service Enablement: Build tooling and guardrails that allow business units to deploy their own data solutions while maintaining global standards for governance and security.
* Performance & Scale: Optimize the "translation" layer to ensure that generated jobs are efficient, cost-effective, and leverage the full power of the Snowflake/dbt stack.
* Developer Experience (DevEx): Act as the "Product Manager" for your platform, gathering feedback from internal users to simplify the data development lifecycle.
* Design and build data pipelines that process billions of records a day across consolidation, semantic, and externalization layers using the DV Internal Data Platform — a self-service, contract-driven architecture where pipelines are defined via YAML contracts and automatically deployed to Snowflake, Airflow, and Looker.
* Develop and extend the Contract Interpreter — a Python library (Pydantic, Jinja2) that reads contract driven platform based YAML and generates dbt models, Airflow DAGs, and environment configurations for each deployment environment (dev, stg, prod).
* Lead new initiatives and integrations with the world's largest social platforms (YouTube, TikTok, Meta, Snapchat, Reddit, Netflix, etc.) to measure ad performance end-to-end.
* Build and maintain the semantic layer — design LookML models, explores, and views that translate consolidated data into customer-ready analytics through Looker.
* Implement and maintain observability — build monitoring, alerting, watermarking, and data consistency checks to ensure pipeline reliability and data freshness at scale.
* Leverage AI agents and tooling — contribute to and use the team's AI agent workspace (meta-repo with AGENTS.md context files, skills, and MCP integrations) to accelerate development, automate workflows, and encode institutional knowledge for AI-assisted engineering.
* Design schema evolution and data migration strategies — manage schema versioning, backward compatibility, incremental vs. full-refresh deployments, and large-scale data backfills.
* Work in multi-functional agile teams with end-to-end responsibility for product development and delivery — from contract definition to customer-facing data.
* Collaborate directly with engineers from partner platforms on API development and data integration specifications.
* Train and mentor a team of software engineers.

**Who You Are**
===============

**Required Experience & Qualifications**
----------------------------------------

* Bachelor's degree or foreign equivalent in Computer Science, Data Engineering, or a related field.
* 5+ years of experience in a Data Engineering or related role.
* Strong SQL skills — advanced querying, performance tuning, window functions, and complex transformations at scale.
* Proficiency in Python — building libraries, data processing scripts, and automation tooling (experience with Pydantic, Jinja2, or similar templating frameworks is a plus).
* Deep experience with Snowflake — schema design, Snowpipe, streams, tasks, materialized views, clustering, and query optimization.
* Experience with dbt (data build tool) — building and maintaining models, macros, custom materializations, and incremental strategies.
* Experience with orchestration tools — Airflow / Cloud Composer, DAG design, scheduling, and monitoring.
* Experience with cloud platforms — GCP (GCS, BigQuery, Cloud Composer, Kubernetes) or equivalent.
* Strong understanding of data warehousing concepts — dimensional modeling, star/snowflake schemas, slowly changing dimensions, fact/aggregate table design, and data consistency patterns.
* Experience with CI/CD pipelines — GitLab CI, Flyway migrations, or similar deployment automation.
* Experience with AI-assisted development tools — Claude Code, Cursor, GitHub Copilot, or similar AI coding assistants. Experience building or contributing to AI agent context files (AGENTS.md), skills, or meta-repo patterns is a strong plus

jobs.description:
The Business Marketing Group connects businesses with their customers on Facebook, Instagram, WhatsApp, and Messenger to help them grow their businesses through solutions like pages, advertising, messaging, and more. We succeed when we help our customers grow their business leveraging our solutions. The Global Marketing Operations team runs campaign execution for business marketing, launching hundreds of campaigns a year across an expanding set of digital marketing channels.We are seeking a Marketing Operations Manager who executes campaigns AI-first, pairing deep expertise in marketing execution platforms with the AI skills to automate that work. This role is about owning operational quality by setting executional standards that can be built at agent scale. The ideal candidate is a digital marketing expert who has already replaced meaningful parts of their own workflow with AI and can show what it produced.  
  
  

### **Marketing Operations Manager Responsibilities:**

* Own campaign execution and execution quality for an assigned business area, from brief through launch, across lifecycle, email, in-product messaging, web, and Meta ads
* Use AI as the primary tool for execution work, including build specification, copy and asset variants, audience logic, and QA
* Build, configure, and test AI agents that execute campaign workflows, and own the automation roadmap for the area, reporting results in turnaround time, cost, and error rate
* Pilot new delivery capabilities, then codify what correct execution looks like and the eval rubrics that hold agents to it
* Advise partners at the brief stage on what is executable and at what cost, and translate execution learnings into platform requirements
* Raise the AI capability of the team through documentation, enablement, and coaching
* Find new ways to continually streamline execution processes, including working with XFNs (if needed) to automate handoff

  
  
  

### **Minimum Qualifications:**

* 6+ years of experience in marketing operations, campaign management, or marketing automation
* Hands-on build experience in at least two digital marketing channels among email, paid social, in-product messaging, web, and SEM or display, with expert-level depth in at least one execution or ads platform (e.g., Salesforce Marketing Cloud, Marketo, HubSpot, Adobe)
* Demonstrated use of AI to produce real marketing work output, with specific examples of what was automated and the measured effect on time, cost, quality, or volume
* Hands-on experience building, configuring, and evaluating AI agents or LLM-based workflows, including prompt iteration and judgment on where output requires human review
* Experience owning campaign execution at portfolio scale, including QA and trade-off decisions across competing requests
* Experience scaling impact beyond own execution, through standards others adopted, requirements platform teams built, and enablement that raised team capability
* Bachelor's Degree or equivalent work experience in digital marketing

  
  
  

### **Preferred Qualifications:**

* Demonstrated ability to integrate AI tools to optimize/redesign workflows and drive measurable impact (e.g., efficiency gains, quality improvements)

* Experience leading the transition of a workflow from manual execution to automated or agentic execution
* Demonstrated ongoing AI skill development (e.g., prompt/context engineering, agent orchestration) and staying current with emerging AI technologies
* Experience connecting AI tools to marketing systems through APIs, integrations, or agent tooling
* SQL fluency or comparable data skills, sufficient to validate audiences and interrogate campaign performance independently
* Comfort working in ambiguity, where the standard does not exist yet and part of the job is writing it

AES has been **ranked #1 by BloombergNEF** in renewable energy sales to corporations in the US and Americas for five consecutive years, providing electricity for **millions of people worldwide.**

Our spirit of innovation continues to earn industry recognition. AES is the only seven-time winner of the Edison Electric Institute’s Edison Awards in the twenty-first century, a distinction honoring global leadership in advancing the electric power industry.  
  
If you're ready to be part of a company that's not just adapting to change, but driving it, AES is the place for you. We're not just building a more sustainable future, we're powering it. Apply now and energize your career with a true leader in global energy.

**Position summary**
====================

The Lead Analyst, Business Transformation leads the day-to-day delivery of adoption consulting work for initiative owners across US Renewables & Power, supporting the adoption and long-term sustainment of cross-functional initiatives. Working under the direction of the Director, Business Transformation, this role sets the practical direction for how adoption work gets executed and serves as the senior hands-on expert on the team.

* **Team guidance:** Mentor and guide fellow analysts on adoption tactical execution work, setting the standard for quality.

* Experience contributing to and helping shape methodologies, frameworks, toolkits, or playbooks for cross-functional work.
* Experience serving as a lead or senior resource on projects, coordinating the work of others and mentoring less-experienced analysts (formal direct-report management not required).

* Strong written and verbal communication skills, with comfort facilitating cross-functional conversations, including at the leadership level.
* Excellent facilitation skills, with experience leading workshops, stakeholder sessions, and planning efforts.

**Preferred attributes**

* Familiarity with adoption measurement.

* Knowledge of the energy industry and renewable generation technologies.
* Proficiency in Microsoft Office 365, including Outlook, Excel, Word, PowerPoint, Teams, OneNote, and SharePoint.

jobs.title: Demand Planner, Strategic Analytics
jobs.description:
Meta is seeking an experienced Demand Planner to support supply chain and business planning functions through rigorous data analysis and forecasting. In this role, you will develop and maintain demand forecasting models that inform inventory positioning, capacity planning, and go-to-market readiness across Meta's hardware and consumer product lines. You will partner closely with supply chain, finance, product, and sales operations teams to translate market signals and business inputs into actionable demand plans that drive efficient resource allocation and minimize supply-demand imbalances.  
  
  

### **Demand Planner, Strategic Analytics Responsibilities:**

* Develop and maintain statistical demand forecasting models that integrate sell-through data, market trends, promotional calendars, and product lifecycle signals
* Own the end-to-end demand planning process for assigned product lines, including baseline forecasting, consensus planning, and exception management
* Analyze historical shipment, inventory, and point-of-sale data to identify demand patterns, forecast variances, and root causes of forecast error
* Collaborate with supply chain, finance, and product teams to align demand plans with inventory targets, capacity constraints, and financial commitments
* Build and maintain centralized planning dashboards and reporting tools that enable automated tracking of forecast accuracy, bias, and key demand planning metrics
* Support monthly and quarterly Sales and Operations Planning processes by delivering demand insights, scenario analyses, and recommendations to planning leadership
* Translate ambiguous business inputs and market intelligence into structured demand assumptions and quantitative forecast adjustments
* Identify gaps in planning data infrastructure and partner with data engineering and analytics teams to prioritize and deliver improvements
* Communicate forecast rationale, risks, and opportunities to cross-functional stakeholders and planning leadership in a clear and structured manner
* Develop scenario and sensitivity analyses to assess the demand impact of product launches, channel shifts, promotional events, and macroeconomic changes

  
  
  

### **Minimum Qualifications:**

* 6+ years of experience in demand planning, supply chain analytics, or business planning with demonstrated ownership of statistical forecasting processes
* Experience building and maintaining demand forecasting models using quantitative and statistical methods
* Experience working with large datasets using SQL or similar data querying tools to extract and analyze supply chain or sales data
* Experience developing planning dashboards and automated reporting tools to support business decision-making
* Experience communicating complex analytical findings and forecast recommendations to cross-functional teams and planning leadership

  
  
  

### **Preferred Qualifications:**

* Familiarity with product lifecycle planning, channel inventory management, or new product introduction forecasting
* Experience adhering to and implementing responsible, ethical AI practices (e.g., risk assessment, bias mitigation, quality and accuracy reviews)
* Demonstrated ongoing AI skill development (e.g., prompt/context engineering, agent orchestration) and staying current with emerging AI technologies
* Demonstrated ability to integrate AI tools to optimize/redesign workflows and drive measurable impact (e.g., efficiency gains, quality improvements)
* Experience using Python or R for statistical modeling and demand signal analysis
* Experience with demand planning software or advanced planning systems such as SAP IBP, Kinaxis, or comparable platforms
* Experience supporting Sales and Operations Planning processes in a consumer electronics or hardware product environment

  
  
  

### **About Meta:**

Meta builds technologies that help people connect, find communities, and grow businesses. When Facebook launched in 2004, it changed the way people connect. The Human Resources Administration (HRA) is dedicated to fighting poverty and income inequality by providing New Yorkers in need with essential benefits such as Food Assistance and Emergency Rental Assistance. As the largest local social services agency in the country, HRA helps more than three million New Yorkers annually through the administration of more than 15 major public assistance programs.
  
  
Housing Services Administration is a division of New York City’s Department of Social Services that oversees housing stability and rehousing efforts. HSA administers rental assistance, housing supply, and placement programs to help individuals and families exit shelter, prevent homelessness, and secure safe, affordable housing across the city.
  
  
The Office of Supportive Housing and Specialized Services helps formerly homeless clients succeed in the community by providing access to permanent housing with support services. Supportive Housing and Specialized Services works closely with other divisions of DSS/HRA/DHS and with other governmental and non-governmental providers to create new programs and to integrate and refine existing services so that clients experiencing homelessness and those at risk can move into safe, affordable housing that best supports their stability and integration in the community.
  
  
Program areas under Supportive Housing & Specialized Services purview include the Coordinated Entry Unit which oversees the Coordinated Assessment and Placement System (CAPS). CAPS serves as NYC’s Coordinated Entry system per the HUD mandate to ensure that localities use a coordinated system to assure systematic and timely referral and placement of homeless and at-risk clients into the most appropriate permanent housing programs. CAPS includes assessment services for individuals/families potentially eligible for supportive housing or rental assistance programs; an application system to determine supportive housing eligibility; a rapid-rehousing request, referral and enrollment module; an electronic referral component; and a vacancy control system to verify and monitor placements.  
  
  
  
The Office of Supportive Housing and Specialized Services is recruiting for one (1) City Research Scientist II to function as a Research Analyst who will support the Director of Coordinated Entry and the Senior Research Analyst by providing research and evaluation to inform the development and implementation of the CAPS Coordinated Entry system and who will:
  
  

* Perform evaluation and research using descriptive, process and outcomes data from CAPS to identify operational efficiencies, assess model fidelity, and inform the development of operational performance measures; this includes extracting CAPS information by writing non-automated SQL and SPSS code and reviewing, quantifying, and analyzing data using various research methodologies.

  

* Support DSS/HRA supportive housing policy directives and respond to data and analytic requests from leadership and external stakeholders by: designing, executing and analyzing analyses of CAPS data; developing non-automated ad hoc SQL code for extraction and analysis of complex data sets; designing, preparing and presenting data visualizations; and disseminating research findings beyond the unit through writing memos and reports including Local Law submissions and creating and delivering presentations.

  

* Monitor administrative CAPS data for survey, application, determination, rapid-rehousing, and vacancy control modules; make and record observations, including developing new recording systems; design and prepare visualizations and communicate findings to internal and external stakeholders.

  

* Prepare responses to legal and media requests, including creating non-automated SQL code to extract and analyze CAPS data.

  

* Support Federal reporting to HUD; validate, troubleshoot, and upload file sets extracted from CAPS into NYC's HMIS data warehouse; collaborate with the Office of Business Strategies and Solutions to refine file generation logic as needed.

  
- Conduct data sharing in support of intra- and interagency research and evaluation efforts.
  
  

* Perform literature and data reviews to evaluate the validity and reliability of prior studies and reports to be used in formulating research questions and future report methodologies.

  

* Perform other related duties as directed.

Prime Video is changing the way customers watch movies, TV shows, live events, and channels—offering unparalleled choice and convenience across devices such as Fire TV, mobile phones, game consoles, and connected TVs. Our mission is to understand and optimize how customers discover, engage with, and return to Prime Video—connecting off-app marketing touchpoints (such as email, push, a.com, WhatsApp, search engines, and paid media) with in-app behavior and engagement to build a complete, end-to-end view of the customer experience. We harness data across this full funnel—from acquisition and onboarding through long-term retention—to inform personalization, measure customer engagement and channel effectiveness, and deliver the right content to the right customer at the right time.

We are looking for a highly motivated and experienced Business Intelligence Engineer (BIE) II to join the PVPA team. In this role, you will play a key part in driving customer understanding through data.

Heady architects purchase experiences in store, online, and through AI agents. You will be expected to coordinate across client, vendor, and internal teams to run thorough testing of our system for ongoing feature development. To be successful in this role, you will need to be proactive in coming up with solutions to not only improve the quality of our product, but also our testing process overall. The role is based in New York, NY, with a hybrid work model (Tuesdays & Wednesdays in the DUMBO, Brooklyn office).
